title: Quote Copilot deal extraction
description: What the model extracts from a deal's discovery-call transcripts (data/deals/<scenario>/C<n>_*.md) and rep notes (rep_notes.md). Written to output/<scenario>/extraction.json and read by scripts/pricing.py, scripts/preflight.py and scripts/sfdc_client.py. Every extracted field is an object {value, source_citation, confidence}. A non-null value MUST carry a citation; a null value (not stated, or conflicting statements) MUST have a null citation. Values are never inferred from indirect evidence, averaged, or picked between conflicting statements: set null and raise an open question instead. Numbers such as prices, totals, ACV/TCV, effective discount, approval level and segment are never extracted or computed here; the scripts compute them.

scenario.description: Optional metadata: the deal folder name under data/deals/ (e.g. clean-midmarket).

source_files.description: Optional metadata: the files read, relative to the project root (e.g. data/deals/clean-midmarket/C1_2026-08-12_discovery.md).

account_domain.description: Customer's primary web domain, lowercase, no scheme or www (e.g. retool.com). Used for the Apollo lookup that sets the verified segment.

company_name.description: Customer company name as written in the rep notes or transcripts.

rep_stated_segment.description: The segment the REP assigned (rep_notes 'Seg:' line). Context only: the pre-flight compares it with the Apollo-verified segment. Never derived from team size or tone.

products.description: Products the customer asked for, by exact price-book name. Platform tiers include no users; named users are 'Additional Seats' with quantity = year-1 seat count (or null when the seat count is null/conflicting). quantity null for an 'Each' product means one subscription. Omit products the customer declined.

seat_count.description: Named-user seats in year 1, as stated by the customer. Integer. Null if never stated or if different values were stated and never reconciled (raise a blocking open question with both candidates).

start_date.description: Subscription start date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), only when a date is stated. Never inferred from call dates, fiscal quarters or dependencies ('after security review' is null + blocking open question).

payment_terms.description: Payment terms the customer requires. Net terms are normalised to 'net<N>' lowercase without a space (net30, net60). Any other terms are written as stated; the pre-flight treats terms it cannot read as net N as non-standard.

requested_discount_pct.description: Discount off list the customer asked for, in percent (12 means 12%). A number 0-100 as stated; never an effective or blended discount (pricing.py computes that).

ramp.description: Seat ramp across years, or null when seats are flat for the term. One step per contract year starting at year 1; year 1 seats must equal seat_count.

company_headcount.description: Total employees of the customer COMPANY, only if someone states it. A team, org or buying-group size is NOT company headcount. Usually null: Apollo is the authority for headcount.

contacts.description: Customer-side people on the calls or in the notes (never the vendor's reps), with job title and buying role.

open_questions.description: Everything unresolved that the rep must answer. Required; may be empty. A null pricing-critical field (products, seat_count, term_months, start_date, requested_discount_pct; see reference/approval_policy.yaml) always has a blocking question.

citation.description: One or more citations joined by ' | '. Each is either a transcript citation C<n> [HH:MM:SS] "<verbatim excerpt>" (the call id from the file name and the turn's timestamp, e.g. C3 [00:09:11] "…more like 80 people…"), a transcript header citation C<n> [header] "<verbatim excerpt>" (participants list), or a rep-notes citation rep_notes: "<verbatim excerpt>". Excerpts are copied verbatim from that turn / line; '…' marks elided text; double quotes inside an excerpt are written as single quotes.

field.description: An extracted field: value (typed per field, null when not stated or unresolved), source_citation (see $defs/citation; null exactly when value is null), confidence (high = stated plainly; medium = stated but approximate or hedged; low = weakly supported).

name.description: Optional: the person's name as written.

field.description: The extraction field the question is about (e.g. seat_count, start_date) or another snake_case topic (e.g. economic_buyer).

text.description: The question or gap in one sentence, naming the stated values and where they came from.

blocking.description: true when the quote cannot be priced or sent until it is answered (any pricing-critical field).

source_citation.description: Optional: where the gap shows (e.g. the dependency statement).

candidates.description: For conflicting statements: every stated value with its citation. The field's own value must then be null.
